title: Orbital Command - Full Game Launched on Steam
author: Enarian__Lead_Dev
selftext:
This is my second game to launch on steam and I was fairly confident that lesson's learnt from my first would make this a calmer less stressfull experience... boy was I wrong!

You can always trust excited players to find the most intricate and elaborate ways to break a game or system, approaches that never even occured to me!

All I can say is thank god for Cursor! Its allowed me to ship out large daily patches, fixing bugs, implementing new systems and feedback from the players.

The game itself is now fantastic, and has never played better, all thanks to the initial players for their amazing support, bug reporting and feedback suggestion.

This started out as a simple 4 week self imposed challenge to see what I could build in 4 weeks from scratch, and the end result was good enough to see the potential and everything epanded from there.

Now is a fantastic time to check out the game, or try the demo.
